title: DEGIRO Order
description: Represents a trading order on the DEGIRO platform, covering creation of LIMIT, MARKET, STOP_LOSS, and STOP_LOSS_LIMIT order types.

orderType.description: Numeric code for the order type: 0=LIMIT, 2=MARKET, 3=STOP_LOSS, 1=STOP_LOSS_LIMIT

price.description: Limit price for LIMIT and STOP_LOSS_LIMIT orders

stopPrice.description: Trigger price for STOP_LOSS and STOP_LOSS_LIMIT orders

productId.description: DEGIRO product identifier for the instrument to be traded

size.description: Quantity of the instrument to buy or sell
